basic_info.description: Located in the heart of Russian Hill near the vibrant energy of nearby Hyde Street and North Beach, this charming studio offers classic San Francisco appeal with thoughtful updates and beautiful bay views. Positioned on the second floor of a 16-unit building, the unit is filled with natural light and showcases timeless period details, including tall ceilings and crown moldings. Freshly painted with new carpet throughout, the home is move-in ready while retaining its historic charm.  The efficient layout includes a spacious living area with a large walk-in closet that provides excellent storage. The eat-in kitchen features a sink, dishwasher, oven range, refrigerator, and room for a small dining table, making it ideal for casual meals or morning coffee. The full bathroom includes a shower over tub, pedestal sink, and vintage tile accents. Additional amenities include shared laundry just down the hall, a private storage area in the basement, and easy access to the best of Russian Hill and North Beach cafes, restaurants, parks, and transit are just moments away. This is a wonderful opportunity to own a bright, well-located home in one of San Francisco's most iconic neighborhoods.
